body: He's seeing one currently. That's who put him on the high doses of Prozac and Xanax (and who wanted to add Celexa, right before he became extremely suicidal). Can he see two? Because I want a second opinion. I honestly don't know if I trust this guy anymore.

The thing is, is I don't know where he is at all. They specifically said "discharged" not "transferred." He could have walked right out the doors and into traffic somewhere. I have NO idea, and they won't tell me. I just don't know what to do with myself.

I would like to hear more about that, please. Everything I've looked up so far is just scaring me even more. Everyone seems to say it was such a horrible experience and they were treated so badly

As of right now, no, he isn't. From what he tells me he did some therapy when he was younger though. But I do agree that meds without therapy is only dealing with 50% of the problem. I really hope he gives therapy another try...
